players.product: low-GWP refrigerants and thermal-management fluids for data-center cooling

quarterly_data.signal: The thermal-management slide of Solstice's investor presentation filed with the Element Solutions merger announcement lists LGWP refrigerants for use in chillers, heat pumps and computer room ACs to provide air cooling to IT hardware; active development of a 2-phase direct-to-chip fluid using a blend of existing molecules; a discovery program to develop a proprietary immersion cooling fluid; and Solstice heat spreaders that conduct heat to the top of the chip package.
